mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (T2.NODE_ID IN (#{BACK_OPERATOR}, #{BACK_CHECKER}) and ','||NEXT_USER||',' LIKE '%,'||'${userName}'||',%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isTodo /*总集节点并且是当前审批用户时*/ FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T1 LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T2 ON T1.SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO WHERE TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and PROCESS_STATE != 'END' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT WHERE TT.SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO AND TT.HIS_NO > T2.HIS_NO) AND ACTION_TYPE NOT IN ('delete', 'revoke')

SELECT min(RAM.AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT) AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT FROM RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG RAM left join SYS_USER SU ON RAM.USER_NAME = SU.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT SD ON SU.DEPT_CODE = SD.DEPT_CODE WHERE (RAM.TRADE_DIRECTION IS NULL OR RAM.TRADE_DIRECTION = #{tradeDirection})
AND (RAM.ASSET_SEC_TYPE IS NULL OR RAM.ASSET_SEC_TYPE = #{assetSecType})
AND (RAM.TRADE_MARKET IS NULL OR RAM.TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket})
AND SD.INSTITUTION_CODE in (#{institutionCode},#{institutionTopCode})
AND RAM.ASSET_TYPE = #{assetType} AND RAM.ROLE_POS = #{rolePos}

SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD A INNER JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PTL ON PTL.ACCT_NO = B.ACCT_NO AND ptl.ACCT_TYPE='A01' WHERE A.FINPROD_ID=#{chlId} AND PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
